name: claim audit (Independent AI, checks by Attested Memory)
description: Independent AI audits a claim by subcontracting Attested Memory, a separate company on its own hub (hub.attestedmemory.net): inside your job it buys Attested's claim.check@v1 (verdict from the evidence you supply) and contradiction.scan@v1 (conflicts among your statements), then answers with both signed findings and a combined verdict (inconsistent when the statements contradict each other, otherwise Attested's status). Send subcontract: {allowance_usd: 0.05}: about $0.032 goes to Attested's two checks through this hub, the rest is released. Your receipt lists theirs as parents.

evidence.description: As Attested's claim.check@v1 takes it: {source_uri, excerpt_hash (sha256:<hex>), stance supports|refutes|context, quality 0..1}

statements.description: Statements to scan for contradictions (lexical negation)

attested.description: Attested's claim_check and contradiction_scan answers, verbatim
